args: From the financial-coach project root, sync and deduplicate raw bank statement PDFs from Google Drive 'gdrive:expense/Statements' into '.cache/statements/' (mounted as '/data/statements' inside the rclone container): (1) Run './scripts/rclone.sh dedupe --dedupe-mode newest gdrive:expense/Statements' to remove duplicate filenames on Google Drive while keeping the newest file. (2) Run './scripts/rclone.sh sync gdrive:expense/Statements /data/statements --exclude Consolidated/**' to mirror each bank folder (AMEX, Barclays, Chase, HSBC) into '.cache/statements/[Bank Name]/*.pdf' without touching '.cache/statements/Consolidated/'. Summarize the deduplication and sync results.
description: Every day at 9:00 AM (Europe/London), deduplicates and syncs raw bank statement PDFs from Google Drive (gdrive:expense/Statements) into .cache/statements/[Bank Name]/ using ./scripts/rclone.sh.
